item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of expert versus loyalist staffing in nuclear/security decisions, politicized nuclear appointments, ideologue-driven nuclear security policy, and institutional safeguards around Akkuyu and CBRN response. I did not find reliable 2024 evidence showing Erdoğan personally stacked nuclear/security decisions with loyalists or ideologues. The best-supported reading is that the nuclear/security side of the state leaned on regulators, inspectors, AFAD, NDK, and international experts, while the main negative evidence is indirect, coming from Turkey’s broader political centralization rather than nuclear-specific staffing.","evidence":[{"title":"International CBRN Congress","publisher":"AFAD","date":"2024-11-20 to 2024-11-22","url":"https://cbrn2024.afad.gov.tr/en/?mbaopn=1","summary":"The congress was organized by AFAD as the coordinator authority for disasters and emergencies and explicitly brought together local and foreign scientists, students, public/private sector representatives, and experts.
